stages.body: Finish the five chapters and enjoy the game. There are no mission gold medals to chase, and the 100% checklist is not even visible until after the story, but everything you do now already counts toward it. Do the optional missions as they appear, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, study new animals through the binoculars, and meditate at every spot you find. All side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal) stay open after the story, so nothing here is time-critical except the one missable meditation below.
stages.title: Step 1 — Play the story
stages.warning: MISSABLE — Positive Mental Attitude: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her and accept. That home meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1 (PowerPyx; GTABase agrees it is the only possibly missable trophy).

stages.body: After the credits, open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the list. It is lenient — roughly 60% true completion — and most of the trophies in this step fall out of it: 300 stunts, gold at all 42 shooting-range challenges, a drone race won at all 14 locations, all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 vehicles scanned and 100 animals studied. Only 15 of 18 meditations and any 100 optional missions are needed, so the checklist forgives gaps.
stages.title: Step 2 — The 100% checklist

stages.body: Strangers & Freaks strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so finish the 8 counting strands now (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pete are confirmed; Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani and Eddie do not count). Then mop up the odd one-offs — the Ocean Beach cocktail and the three trophies no guide has pinned down yet — and the platinum pops.
stages.title: Step 3 — Strangers, oddities, platinum
stages.warning: Four trophies still have no confirmed method as of 19 November 2026 (PowerPyx): In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin. Their guides say so honestly instead of guessing.

summary: One playthrough, about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx). No mission replay, but free-roam stays open after the story and nothing except one Chapter 1 meditation can be missed. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots) and keep cheats off: they disable trophies and saving.
title: Roadmap to the platinum
